notes.title: HAS ARRIVED !! KEEP RUNNNING 2.0 UPDATE IN BETA PLAY AND TRY NOW !!!
notes.notes:
Hello born runner, I come to show you the latest update of my Keep Running game, I've been studying hard about developing games, and this update is just the tip of what's to come, I decided to spice up this new mode is  FREE, because I am grateful for those who gave feedback, thus contributing so that I could make improvements and think of a new game mode. As you may have seen in the upper case letters, this update is in phase  BETA  so bugs may occur during gameplay, if so, you can immediately let me know that I will be ready to fix it.

  Also if you have ideas for contributing to the game, such as items, or some kind of enhancement, post it in the comments because I read them all = D  

  STORY  

So basically in this new mode you control a boy named Kai, who woke up in a hospital. Not knowing what to do and scared, Kai starts to run desperately, but after some time running he realizes that the hospital corridor seems endless. With no choice to think, stop running or rest Kai keeps running for his life, while a demon behind is about to kill him for some reason.

  Purpose and Tips  

[olist]
 Run and dodge the hospital objects that come your way as they will push you towards the demon.
 The devil can only catch you if you are in the same direction line as him.
 Do not let objects push you because if dropped is left behind it will die.
[/olist]

  CHANGES AND UPDATES  

Now you can:
[olist]
 Choose a resolution from the home screen options menu.
 Select the "FULL SCREEN" option.
 Move the graphics (If your pc chokes put on the bottom)
[/olist]
